messages:
pagerbot: [ALERT] p99 latency spike detected for dedicated pool eu1-hotshot-23. p99=4.2s, p95=1.8s. Streaming stalls and tail latency rising. Paging @sam for on-call.
sam: ack, joining incident channel now :eyes:
sam: can someone post quick signal summary? what's the customer impact?
elena: grafana: queue_depth eu1-hotshot-23 jumped 20 -> 240 in ~60s. warmup queue growth visible. autoscaler scaleup delayed (~90s). link: https://redwood.internal/grafana/d/pool-eu1
mohit: quick query: top callers are a burst from AcmeCorp (webhook flood). kv-cache cold fraction jumped to 63% for this pool, causing more warmup stalls. streaming sessions with stalls show repeated <KEEPALIVE> retransmits.
taylor: support notes: 3 enterprise customers reported higher latencies and some mid-stream dropped frames for streaming responses. estimated 8-12% of requests at p99.
sam: mitigation plan: steer non-sensitive tenants off the dedicated hotshot pool to hosted fallback, throttle AcmeCorp bursts at ingress, and raise handshake timeout to avoid warmup cancellations. executing now.
sam: /ops reroute --from=eu1-hotshot-23 --to=eu1-shared-hosted-1 --filter="tenant not in (AcmeCorp,FinReg)"
ops-bot: Command accepted. Starting connection rebalance and drain. Estimated rebalancing window 45s. :white_check_mark:
elena: also bumping handshake_timeout from 30s -> 45s for pool eu1-hotshot-23 to reduce premature warmup aborts. applying config patch.
mohit: logs show autoscaler reconcile task lagging behind rate-limit checks. filing a follow-up but will also increase reconcile frequency as a quick mitigation (delta +2s polling).
taylor: heads-up to sales/support: informing affected accounts and CSMs. message: "We've rerouted traffic and are mitigating warmup; you may see transient higher token counts while we stabilize."
support-lead: notified AcmeCorp CSM and provided temporary workaround. They reported 20% streaming error spike, will escalate to account execs if not resolved in next 30m.
sam: monitoring metrics now. p99 dropped from 4.2s -> 1.2s after reroute. p95 stable. streaming stall rate decreased by ~70% within two windows. continuing to observe for 15m.
elena: preliminary root cause hypothesis: dedicated autoscaler didn't parallelize warmup sufficiently under hotshot burst, causing handshake backlog and queue amplification. follow-ups: adjust warmup concurrency, add early-fallback circuit to steer traffic sooner, and add warmup-queue-lag metric/alert.
mohit: created jira REDWOOD-8421 with logs, queries, and proposed code-level mitigation for autoscaler reconcilers.
sam: plan to close page if stable after 10m. tagging incident: actions = [reroute to hosted fallback, handshake_timeout bump, autoscaler reconcile frequency bump]. @pagerbot please annotate the incident ticket with actions and jira link.
pagerbot: Incident annotated: severity S3, actions logged (reroute, handshake_timeout change, REDWOOD-8421). Duration so far: 12m. Will auto-close page on stable signals. :white_check_mark:
